feeds.title: It's Great to Be Gluten-Free Blog
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date with the latest gluten-free news, tips, and advice for families on our website! From expert advice to delicious gluten-free alternatives, we have everything you need to live your best gluten-free life. Don't miss a beat - visit us now.

feeds.title: The Israel Bites Blog
feeds.description: I'm a 20 something year old wanna a globetrotter with the Celiac disease currently living in The Holy City. I am a major foodie and in Israel, navigating being gluten free is no easy task. When I got here, I quickly realized there were no English resources for people with gluten intolerances or Celiac Disease. Thus, TheIsraelBites was born! TheIsraelBites is has become so much more than just a resource for places to eat within the country. This page is also home to my favorite recipes, travel tips, and more!

feeds.title: Celiac.com
feeds.description: News, information and support for those on a gluten-free diet due to celiac disease or gluten sensitivity. The purpose of Celiac.com is to provide people who have celiac disease and are not aware of it with a means of figuring out what their problem is, and to help those who know they have it to lead more comfortable and healthy lives.

feeds.title: Becky Excell
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Becky Excell. Welcome to my gluten-free food blog. I'm a London/Essex-based food writer, recipe creator, and a Sunday Times best-selling author. The blog covers baking, breakfast, lunch, dinner, desserts, dairy-free, vegan, low fodmap, and smoothies recipes. Also covers articles on life and travel.

feeds.title: Gluten Free Indian
feeds.description: Hi! I am Khushboo. I am gluten intolerant and this is my Gluten-free food diary - not necessarily fancy recipes, just what I eat on a day-to-day basis as well as my food discoveries, to give you some inspiration. I try to make gluten-free food enjoyable & affordable. If they can make it with gluten, we can make it without. This is a blog for anyone who wants to eat healthy and delicious food, my recipes are not complicated, I have kept it simple so that anyone can cook. If you can make tea then you should be able to make these dishes too.

feeds.title: Gluten Free Dad
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Lenny, the Gluten-Free Dad! I'm just an average guy who loves his family, his country, playing soccer, and supporting Carolina Panthers football. My gluten-free journey is just beginning as I have voluntarily eliminated gluten from my diet to support the love of my life, Aimee, who doesn't have a choice. I've been intermittent fasting for over two years with great success. Now throw in the challenges of 'dodging the G' and follow me as I document the new experiences, trials, and tips when living a gluten-free lifestyle.

feeds.title: The Gluten & Dairy-Free Review Blog
feeds.description: Gluten-free and dairy-free blog reviewing restaurants and products, as well as sharing tips about living with dietary restrictions.

feeds.title: Gluten Free Eye
feeds.description: We are dedicated to the pursuit of living a happy and healthy gluten free lifestyle! Dawn Brangman, also known as the Gluten Free Eye, was diagnosed with Celiac Disease in 2002. Dawn is a gluten free baker, vlogger and advocate. For over a decade, Dawn has been inspiring people to enjoy the health benefits of being educated about food ingredients and labeling.

feeds.title: VeguKate
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Kate Gavlick, a Nutritionist with an immense passion for real, whole foods. Wth this blog I hope to vegukate you on all things health, food, and wellness. I'm positively passionate over chickpeas, I crave avocados and all things green, and quinoa makes me dance.

feeds.title: Grateful Gluten Free
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Liz. I'm the mom of two amazing children who happen to have celiac disease. After gluten avoidance, sustainability is the driving force of our food choices. When it comes to food, what is better for the planet is typically healthier for us, too. Grateful GF is a collection of family-friendly recipes and activities, as well as information about living gluten-free sustainably.
